items.title: TAVI vs SAVR in low-risk AS: mortality higher with TAVI at 5-7 years (EACTS 2026)
items.summary: Time-dependent pooled analysis of PARTNER 3, Evolut Low Risk and NOTION (2,644 low-risk patients) found a nonsignificant early survival trend favouring TAVI that reversed over time, with significantly higher TAVI mortality at 5-7 years.
bullets: Pooled 7-year data from PARTNER 3, Evolut Low Risk and NOTION: 2,644 low-surgical-risk patients randomised to TAVI or SAVR.
7-year all-cause mortality 26.9% with TAVI vs 23.7% with SAVR (absolute difference 3.2%); overall HR 1.14, not significant, and hazards were not proportional.
Time-dependent HRs: 0.61 at 0-1 year, 0.84 at 1-3 years, 1.05 at 3-5 years, and 1.64 (95% CI 1.27-2.12) at 5-7 years; 49% of TAVI deaths occurred in years 5-7.
Not significant when Evolut Low Risk was excluded (HR 1.39); experts flag differential loss to follow-up, unknown causes of death and possible valve-type effects.
Presented at EACTS 2026 (Barcelona, Oct 9); outside experts called the data preliminary; authors urge heart-team caution offering TAVI to younger low-risk patients.

items.title: FDA early alert: Edwards removes 4 lots of SAPIEN M3 TMVR delivery system after balloon bursts
items.summary: FDA flagged a potentially high-risk issue with Edwards' Commander M delivery system for SAPIEN M3 transseptal TMVR: three balloon bursts during inflation, with one death and one serious injury reported as of October 5.
bullets: Affected: Commander M delivery systems for SAPIEN M3 TMVR, lots 67718561, 67804014, 67887043 and 67887044; other lots are not affected.
Edwards received three reports of the balloon bursting during inflation; one death and one serious injury reported as of October 5, 2026.
Risks include embolism and inability to retrieve the device through the guide sheath, possibly needing surgery in patients already deemed unsuitable for it.
Action: do not use the listed lots, remove them from inventory and return them via Edwards; FDA is still reviewing the issue.

SAPIEN M3 was FDA-approved in December 2025 (single-arm ENCIRCLE trial) for symptomatic moderate-to-severe MR or symptomatic MAC-related mitral valve dysfunction in patients unsuitable for surgery or TEER.
